name: useLocation
summary: Position, altitude, heading and speed from expo-location.
plain: Where the phone is, how accurate that is, which way it is pointing and how fast it is moving. Latitude and longitude are null until the first fix. Always check accuracy before trusting a fix, and check permission before assuming you will get one at all.
description: Takes one fix from expo-location (getCurrentPositionAsync, Accuracy.Highest); it does not report which receiver or band produced it. Latitude and longitude are null until the first fix arrives, including when permission is denied. The accuracy value is the radius in metres that the platform believes the position lies within; indoors it can be tens of metres and should gate any decision made from the coordinates. Heading and speed are only meaningful while actually moving.

returns.name: latitude
returns.desc: Decimal degrees north; null until the first fix.

returns.name: longitude
returns.desc: Decimal degrees east; null until the first fix.

returns.name: altitude
returns.desc: Metres above sea level, less reliable than the horizontal position.

returns.name: accuracy
returns.desc: Radius in metres the fix is confident within. Check this before trusting the position.

returns.name: heading
returns.desc: Direction of travel in degrees, meaningful only while moving.

returns.name: speed
returns.desc: Ground speed in metres per second.

returns.name: hasPermission
returns.desc: Whether fine location permission was granted.

returns.name: isLocating
returns.desc: `true` while a fix is being acquired, which can take seconds on a cold start.

returns.name: hasFix
returns.desc: Whether a position has been obtained this session. This, not `latitude`, is the "do I have a location" flag.

returns.name: lastFixAt
returns.desc: Epoch milliseconds when the last fix arrived, for showing how stale it is.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Why the last attempt failed, including `'Location permission denied'`.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: `'hardware'` once a fix exists, `'unavailable'` before that.

actions.name: refreshLocation()
actions.desc: Requests permission if needed and takes a fresh highest-accuracy fix.
actions.output: Resolves true when a fix arrived, false when permission was denied or the fix failed, with the reason in error. Coordinates never reach the log.

agentNote: Never present coordinates without their accuracy. Request permission in response to a user action, not on mount.
